desc:
Step into the paws of a shelter dog in Canine Chaos! 

💥 Fight other dogs
🤝 Make friends or enemies
📈 Level up for stat boosts
🦴 Collect bones to unlock different breeds and customizations

🛠️ Game is currently in alpha and early development, expect bugs and several changes.

CONTROLS
F to stun attack
Z to toggle between walk/trot
X to toggle between canter/sprint
T to sniff and highlight a bone pile
R to rest
B to bark
G to growl
Y to playbow

Game icon by @X8GY
